notes: Adding a scene now jumps to the new scene instead of the top. Before, adding a scene rebuilt the list and bounced you to the top of the page, so you had to scroll all the way down to find the scene you just added. Now it scrolls straight to the new scene (added at the bottom), or selects it in Timeline view. Same fix applied to Duplicate and Add-from-draft, which were trying to scroll to the wrong element and silently doing nothing.
